quotes.text: "text after the inline image should be quoted in the forwarded body"
"the inline image should carry over as the sole attachment when forwarded"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The fixture places an inline PNG between two unnamed us-ascii text/plain parts. The browser task directly checks that both text fragments are quoted and that the one attachment is pixel.png, image/png and nonempty. It does not compare image contents, visual position or cover mixed charsets/named text/HTML in this case. The helper and assertions were inspected; no browser or compose run occurred.
title: The sandwiched-image forward test checks text and attachment metadata, not image equivalence
